actions.oldValue: Revival produced by Scott Rudin, Barry Diller and Roy Furman; opened Apr 9, 2026 and closed Aug 9, 2026, grossing about $36.9M. Capitalized for $8 million, per The New York Times (Jun 8, 2026), against a Form D offering ceiling of $8.9 million. The Hollywood Reporter noted after closing that no recoupment had been announced (these producers typically do not announce one). A BroadwayWorld forum poster estimated in June that it was about three weeks from recouping; that is a guess, not a report. Its SEC Form D (Loman Broadway Ltd Liability Co, CIK 0002107826, signed Feb 3, 2026) offered $8,900,000 with $0 sold at filing, before the first sale: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2107826/000210782626000001/xslFormDX01/primary_doc.xml
